reviews.text: Thank you Elena for the trust you have given us by giving us 5 stars.
Hi Cristina, thank you for your trust and the 5-star rating. We look forward to seeing you soon.
Excellent service! Every time it's a positive experience for my Mountain Dog! Highly recommended!
Thank you Michela for the 5 stars you gave us. See you soon and

Very well-kept shop, very kind staff, and a sweet and super-good groomer! We have a great experience there, and my toy poodle, Lilly, loves going there and comes out wonderful and soft as a fluff ball! Fair prices and lots of beautiful things to buy for our furry friends! I highly recommend this shop!
Very kind and helpful

Perfect!!
Fantastic self-service car wash, a real spa for our puppy!
Excellent service! And the haircut looked great!!
great service! very kind
Very satisfied. I got the card for 5 treatments + 1 free.

A one-of-a-kind place for dog care...
Luca is extremely kind and available to answer questions, finding the perfect day and time for you and your little, great pup.
Fantastic grooming...very kind staff and there is also the possibility of doing it yourself..you don't need anything, they have everything..just bring your furry friend!

A fantastic experience! I found this shop by chance because my dog ​​(a senior Great Dane) had special dietary needs, and I found Petland to be a great resource. Excellent quality products and incredibly friendly and knowledgeable staff. I also used their self-care service and it was truly a five-star experience. Special thanks to Luca... his advice is always a guarantee!
Penelope and I are now loyal customers!

I have been taking my poodle there for over a year. The shop is very clean, the staff are very nice, and they take great care of my Charly. He loves his snacks and biscuits. He always comes out happy and smelling good. I have to say that I really like the cut. I recommend it.
Kind, good relationship with animals, good work done at acceptable costs
Highly recommended, our dog is always super pampered!

A truly positive experience. The team is knowledgeable, kind, and very attentive to the animals' needs. They used top-quality products, and the results were immediately visible: my puppy was gorgeous and happy. A place I'd definitely return to!
Very professional, well-prepared and kind, excellent range of quality food and accessories, very good at grooming even for wire-haired dachshunds!
Very helpful and give you tons of advice!
Excellent! I always take my dog ​​Gigio for grooming, and I'm very happy with it! True professionals, a well-kept environment, and very kind and reliable staff. I recommend it to everyone!
Friendly and helpful staff! Fast and they even have options for dogs with sensitive skin!
Thank you for the 5 stars and your trust.

Today I took my dog ​​Artù to the groomer for the first time and I was really satisfied! The guy was kind and helpful right from the start, even on the phone. Once we arrived, the woman who greeted us was incredibly sweet and took great care of Artù. After about an hour, I came back to pick him up, and he was spotless, well-groomed, and smelling great. Since it was my first time, I was a little hesitant, but everything went great. I also really appreciated the gesture of giving me a chew I wanted to buy. Excellent service and truly friendly staff: I'll definitely be back next time!

I've been taking my cat to Petland CityLife for grooming for a while now, and I'm very happy with them! They're always super fast, reliable, and above all, super sweet with him 🐱
Every time he comes back, he's perfect and doesn't shed a hair for weeks... they save my life every time!
Highly recommended! 💯
We chose Petland Citylife for our miniature poodle's first bath and grooming... a perfect job... truly reliable and professional... we highly recommend it to everyone

They perfectly understood how I wanted my Schnoodle’s (Schnauzer/Poodle) cut to be. They are super friendly, reasonably priced and quick and my dog loves the treats she been given. I can highly recommend them

I highly recommend Petland. Perdona is very kind, excellent service.
I'm very happy with the washing and grooming services.

A super positive experience. I've been taking my Kira for a nail trim for a few months now, and they're super kind, helpful, and above all patient (given my 15-year-old Spitz's temperament). A solid 5 stars, well deserved.
Optimal!
Kind, attentive, thoughtful and punctual

I brought my golden retriever for grooming and I'm very satisfied! The staff was welcoming and professional, making Lea feel at ease.
The grooming was impeccable: her coat was shiny, smelled good, and her nails were well-groomed. The environment was clean and the prices were fair.
I highly recommend this center for anyone who loves their pets. We'll definitely be back!
Friendly staff, a special thanks to Tommaso for his professionalism, my Dogue de Bordeaux came out happy

I went to Petland to get my cat groomed and had a really great experience. Everyone was super kind and professional, and you could tell they know how to treat animals with care.

I was also pleased with the welcome: they offered me a coffee and there's a comfortable waiting room. Plus, the shop is well-stocked, with lots of products for dogs and cats.

I'll definitely be back, highly recommended!

I brought my ragdoll Artù with me. I was really nervous because he had a lot of knots, even on his belly. We had a great time. Adriana was very professional, patient and loving, and spent over an hour detangling and shaving the knots. I highly recommend her! Thank you!
Charlie my Golden is a loyal customer, the place is clean and fragrant, the service is punctual, the staff is friendly and courteous! I recommend it!

Bruce's first grooming: wash and haircut. We picked him up looking ready for a show 😍
We're truly satisfied! Congratulations on perfectly grooming our American Golden Retriever. Highly recommended! …

Simply excellent!
Everyone was very kind and professional.
Highly recommended to everyone.
Teo's fur afterwards was so soft and looked like a cloud.
Thanks guys!

I've been taking my Lhasa Aspo to PetLand in City Life for a while now. Courtesy and thoroughness are the key ingredients. They're truly professionals and can also give excellent advice. Highly recommended for anyone who wants the best for their furry friend.

I had a great time! I brought both my cats for a bath and the experience was truly positive. They were treated with great kindness and professionalism, and they behaved very well thanks to the attentive and calm staff. You can tell they love animals and know how to make them feel at ease. I will definitely be back and recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and competent groomer!
Advised
Great experience, they are very good!! I recommend them ☺️
I took my Toller Retriever to the groomer; I'm very happy. Leo is calm and happy, his coat is shiny, and the grooming is very professional. We'll be back!
very welcoming place
They're very kind and I had a great experience. Sally is very comfortable and always comes out looking perfect.

I can't help but give it the highest score.
Our LULA (a 5-year-old Leonberger) was super pampered by the staff.
Professional and excellent. Our little girl was calm and at ease.
She's beautiful and we, her owners, are calm and very happy with how she was welcomed.
Highly recommended!!!!! Lula has signed up for a membership!!!!
Excellent service, helpful and very kind staff!!!!
Friendly staff and fast service
The best groomer in Milan! Self-service available too!
Great job on my baby! And so quick!
♥️♥️♥️ very good♥️♥️♥️
I took my Maine Coon cat to have her tangles removed (she had a lot of them). We had a great experience. The staff is very professional, patient, and kind.

Yesterday, Coco, my Samoyed, had her first grooming session at Petland. They were very satisfied, professional, precise, and friendly. Excellent work done with passion and care. I've never had Coco look so good unless she was groomed at the kennel. They also offer self-bathing and ozone therapy.
Well done, well done (the prices are absolutely in line).

Professional, knowledgeable, and helpful
I highly recommend them.
Excellent grooming. They took all my requests into account. They work very quickly. I will definitely be back.
Really welcoming, courteous and well organised!
Thank you Letizia for the 5 stars and for your trust. Beautiful Milos, waiting for the little award. See you next time.

I couldn't have asked for anything better, a great experience.
I'll definitely be back.

I regularly take my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel for grooming, and I've been happy with them from the first time. The staff is very kind and knowledgeable, and they know how to treat my shy dog, who's a bit wary of bathing and drying. I also recommend them to anyone who wants to groom themselves; they have a dedicated area for that.
My Pomeranian has been coming to PetLand since he was a puppy. I'm always satisfied! We use his kibble and he's never had any tear stains. I highly recommend him. ❤️
